stories.story_fr: Jabil releve pour la troisieme fois son objectif de chiffre d'affaires FY2026, desormais fixe a 34 milliards de dollars, soit une hausse de 9% par rapport a l'objectif initial.
stories.story_en: Jabil raises its FY2026 revenue guidance for the third consecutive time to $34B, up 9% from the initial $31.3B target set at the start of the fiscal year.
stories.quote: we are raising our fiscal 2026 outlook for revenue and core EPS

stories.story_fr: Le segment Intelligent Infrastructure affiche une demande robuste portee par l'IA, les centres de donnees et les infrastructures cloud, devenant le principal moteur de croissance de Jabil.
stories.story_en: The Intelligent Infrastructure segment shows robust demand driven by AI, data centers, and cloud infrastructure, becoming Jabil's primary growth engine in FY2026.
stories.signal: IA et cloud tirent la croissance
stories.quote: continued momentum in Intelligent Infrastructure, where demand remains robust across cloud and data center infrastructure

stories.story_fr: Le BPA core devrait atteindre 12,25 dollars en FY2026, en hausse de 26% par rapport au BPA de 9,75 dollars enregistre en FY2025, une progression record pour Jabil.
stories.story_en: Core EPS is on track to reach $12.25 in FY2026, up 26% from the $9.75 recorded in FY2025, representing a record earnings trajectory for Jabil.
stories.quote: tracking toward record core earnings per share

stories.story_fr: Les secteurs automobile et energies renouvelables surpassent les attentes en Q2 FY2026, signalant une reprise plus rapide que prevu dans les industries reglementees apres une periode de faiblesse.
stories.story_en: Automotive and renewable energy sectors outperform expectations in Q2 FY2026, signaling a faster-than-expected recovery in regulated industries after a period of weakness.
stories.signal: Auto et EnR rebondissent au-dessus des attentes
stories.quote: automotive and renewables performing better than we anticipated earlier in the year

stories.story_fr: La presence industrielle significative de Jabil aux Etats-Unis devient un avantage competitif cle pour ses clients dans un contexte de tensions geopolitiques et de reconfigurations des chaines d'approvisionnement.
stories.story_en: Jabil's significant U.S. manufacturing footprint becomes a key competitive advantage for its customers amid geopolitical uncertainty and supply chain reconfiguration trends.
stories.signal: Empreinte US valorisee par les clients
stories.quote: our designation as a U.S. domiciled manufacturing service provider and our significant U.S. footprint is becoming increasingly important for our customers
